architecture.atom: ONE BITE-SIZE SUBJECT FOR ONE FRESH TEST TAKER INSIDE THAT TEST TAKER'S OWN ACTIVE NATIVE CODEX GOAL
architecture.distinction: The initial collaboration task remains in its first turn after native Goal activation by blocking inside one exact mailbox exec call. The parent publishes the predeclared subject only after the wait process is ready and the raw trace proves the matching Goal is ACTIVE. No followup, second task turn, resident task, recovery task, or public resume surface exists.
architecture.qualification_rule: THE CANARY AND ALL COMPONENT OR REVIEW EVIDENCE HAVE ZERO QUALIFICATION CREDIT; ONLY MATRIX 013 AND MATRIX 014 MAY FORM THE REQUIRED TWO-CONSECUTIVE-CLEAN-MATRIX STREAK

bite_size_contract.subject_transport: SOLE STDOUT OF THE ONE BLOCKING WAIT CALL

child_contract.final_contract: After update_goal returns COMPLETE, emit exactly the predeclared result token and end the task.
child_contract.fresh_goal: create_goal uses the exact predeclared objective and must return ACTIVE before the wait call
child_contract.initial_prompt: CONTROL ONLY; EXACT OBJECTIVE, WAIT COMMAND, WORKDIR, YIELD, OUTPUT LIMIT, AND RESULT RULE; NO SUBJECT OR SCORER BYTES
child_contract.single_turn: Exactly one turn_context and one task_complete. The blocking wait prevents a turn boundary between ACTIVE and subject delivery.
child_contract.subject_work: Interpret only the wait call's exact stdout as the subject; perform no further tool call before update_goal complete.

EXEC_WRAPPED_V1.wrapper_grammar: ANCHORED CLOSED TOKEN GRAMMAR: one const binding, one awaited tools call with the exact closed argument object, text of that binding or wait output, and only the observed session_id diagnostic branch on the wait wrapper; no additional statement or nested tool

event_normalization.closed_world: Every response-item tool carrier must normalize to exactly one of the three ordered semantic calls under one accepted profile. Mixed profiles, pre-create get_goal, extra calls, malformed outputs, duplicate call IDs, or unknown carriers consume the row.
event_normalization.goal_active_output: Exact finite create_goal result whose goal.threadId equals the waiter argument, objective equals the predeclaration, and status is active
event_normalization.goal_complete_output: Exact finite update_goal result for the same thread/objective whose status is complete

evidence_contract.live_trace_gate: After ready.json exists, derive the one trace from its goal_thread_id, reopen the stable prefix, and require create_goal ACTIVE then the pending exact wait call with no update_goal, final, task_complete, second turn_context, or subject-visible content before publication.
evidence_contract.post_task_trace: After task_complete, copy the stable exact source trace create-only, fsync, reopen, hash, and independently reparse the complete one-turn lifecycle.
evidence_contract.trace_discovery: ready.json supplies the exact lowercase Goal thread ID; exactly one regular nonlink rollout filename and session_meta.id may match that ID
evidence_contract.write_contract: CREATE-ONLY, FSYNC FILE AND PARENT, REOPEN EXACT; NO ROW FILE IS REWRITTEN

failure_rules: Any subject or scorer bytes visible in the initial task prompt, predeclaration, Goal objective, or trace before ACTIVE consumes the row
Any task turn boundary, task final, Goal completion, update_goal, or collaboration followup before subject publication consumes the row
Any missing, late, malformed, mismatched, symlinked, nonregular, wrong-owner, wrong-mode, or reused mailbox/trace/Goal/task identity consumes the row
Any wait command drift, wrapper drift, session yield, timeout, child poll, parent resend, extra tool, mixed event profile, or unknown event consumes the row
Any subject hash, result, Goal terminal, task terminal, trace, scorer, inventory, or accounting mismatch consumes the row
One consumed row fails its canary or full matrix. No salvage, recovery, replacement, or streak credit exists.

loop_breaker.canary_rule: C02 is the sole fresh canary for this exact architecture identity. A normalized recurrence of either C01 failure family rejects V6; do not patch or rerun C02.
loop_breaker.design_rule: One fresh Goal-native atomic review may admit implementation. A hard failure rejects this exact design identity; corrections require a new identity and may not reinterpret the failed review.
loop_breaker.matrix_rule: Matrix 013 and Matrix 014 each launch at most once and only sequentially after the exact predecessor passes. A failed matrix is permanently zero credit and breaks the streak.

mailbox_contract.publication: Only after the parent gate passes, create subject.stage exclusively, fsync and reopen exact bytes/hash, use same-directory linkat to create the absent subject.txt name without overwrite, fsync the mailbox directory, reopen subject.txt and require the same inode plus exact bytes/hash, unlink subject.stage, fsync the mailbox directory again, require the stage absent, and never modify subject.txt.

subject.framing: ONE NONEMPTY UTF-8 LINE PLUS LF

mailbox_contract.waiter: Bound Python bytes accept only the Goal thread ID argument, exact-reopen predeclaration, create ready.json O_EXCL, fsync/reopen it, wait monotonically for absent-to-present subject.txt without following links, validate exact metadata/bytes/hash, write the subject bytes once to stdout, and exit zero. Timeout or drift exits nonzero without subject stdout.

nonclaims: The prior blocking capability is diagnostic evidence, not authority for C02 or a matrix.
The failed capability review remains a failure and is not relabeled by this design.
Requested model and reasoning effort plus turn_context are route evidence, not effective-provider attestation.
A correct answer, Goal receipt, ready file, or static PASS alone is not protocol, canary, matrix, or qualification success.
The external Windows OMP lane is separately owned and frozen; this design neither inspects nor waits for it.

before_publish_all: fresh task exists under the exact requested route with fork_turns none
ready.json is exact and binds the fresh Goal thread ID
raw trace prefix has exactly one turn_context with the requested model and reasoning effort
raw trace prefix normalizes exactly create_goal ACTIVE then the one pending wait call
Goal objective, task path, nonce, waiter, mailbox, and trace identities match the predeclaration
no update_goal, task final, task_complete, second turn, followup, subject, scorer, retry, reuse, or replacement exists
